description: China’s Roads Network and Material Stocks Database in 2021 (CRANMS) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Ruiyao Li et al. China’s rapid urbanization has led to a substantial increase in material stocks, particularly in road construction with cement being a major component. Accurate knowledge of road material stocks and their distribution are used to construct material stocks and flows accounts and promote sustainable resource management. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2183106605 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
